subject: general
question:
The following pie charts show the number of start-ups started in various sectors since 2016 and the number of successful start-ups in those sectors respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0f1a9bbf2c72b6e0f53be6ad88974007db5ad97c55d10149b8ac2ac2b37098f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dd5a31238fb9a93d95f322cdf1607c8c663b35abc3d10cbf870092762ca8315.png] 

Out of all the start-ups that started since 2016, what percentage (approx. up to two decimal places)of startups started in travel sector?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total start-up started = 720 + 256 + 650 + 324 + 560

⇒ 2510

Start-up in the travel sector = 324

Required % = (324/2510) × 100

⇒ 12.90.8 ≈ 12.91%

**∴ The required answer is 12.91%.**
